messages:
Jen (PM): Quick sync — need to finalize Q3 priorities for Private Deploy roadmap (VPC control plane, on-prem packaging, air-gapped). Who's around?
Maria (Eng): here. Is this the kube vs packaged distro tradeoff convo?
Ajay (Arch): yup. Must include SLA and Dedicated integration considerations.
Sam (ML): which customers are pushing airgap vs VPC CP?
Lina (DevEx): support intel: 3 enterprise deals need airgap (finance/health), 5 want VPC control plane, 2 want fully on-prem tarball packaging.
Jen (PM): proposal: Phase A = VPC control plane (fastest path to revenue). Phase B = on-prem packaged bundle. Phase C = full air-gapped installer. Thoughts?
Ajay (Arch): sequencing +1, but we need concrete acceptance criteria for Phase A: control plane in customer VPC, KMS (AWS/GCP) support, logs forwarded to customer SIEM, network peering config, and a rollout playbook.
Maria (Eng): add: automated rollback/fallback to hosted runtime when control plane connectivity is degraded — protects latency SLOs. Non-negotiable.
Jen (PM): Draft launch criteria for Phase A:
- control plane deploys to customer VPC
- KMS integration (AWS KMS + GCP KMS)
- audit logs delivered to customer endpoint/SIEM
- SLA: 99.95% control plane availability
- automated failover to hosted runtime requests

Approvals? :thinking_face:
Sam (ML): how much effort for KMS/GCP work? estimate?
Ajay (Arch): rough: 4w for core integration + 2w security review + docs if we parallelize.
Lina (DevEx): Phase B packaging needs signed artifacts, installer tooling, and distro docs. If we pull engineers from Phase A early we delay PKI/signing work.
Jen (PM): heads-up: a healthcare prospect is asking for on-prem air-gapped by Sept. If LOI is real we may need to reorder.
Maria (Eng): we should request LOI/TOS from Sales before we shift priorities — airgap is expensive (eng hours + SOC audit + support).
Jen (PM): @Sales can you confirm LOI? Lina, please add a cost delta in the PRD.
Lina (DevEx): will do — adding a breakdown: engineering hours, SOC audit, packaging, on-call support uplift.
deploy-bot: Issue created: INTERNAL-4872 "VPC control plane launch criteria checklist" assigned to Ajay (Arch)
Ajay (Arch): taking it. I'll post a short runbook draft by EOD.
Maria (Eng): propose healthcheck/rollback timings: probe interval 5s, 30s grace window before failover.
Jen (PM): Action items:
- Ajay (Arch): PRD + runbook for Phase A (due in 3 business days)
- Lina (DevEx): PRD section with customer asks and cost delta (due in 2 business days)
- Jen (PM): confirm LOI from Sales by Friday
- Maria (Eng): draft failover SLO language & testing plan (due in 4 business days)

Any objections? :thumbsup:
Sam (ML): :thumbsup:
Ajay (Arch): :thumbsup:
Maria (Eng): :thumbsup:
Lina (DevEx): :thumbsup:
Jen (PM): I'll lock this into the roadmap after LOI. If an airgap LOI arrives we reconvene and rebaseline scope.
